commands.name: audit

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: A folder inside the env. The nem config is looked up  from there upwards.

commands.description: Lists the known vulnerabilities in the env's  installed tools. 'nem install' only prints the count.

commands.name: init

arguments.name: nodeVersion
arguments.description: The Node version the env is initialized for. Partial  versions ("22", "18.12") resolve to the newest matching  release.

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: The path of the folder the env is created in.

commands.description: Creates a nem env (a nem.jsonc) for a project.

commands.name: install

options.name: --clean
options.description: Reinstalls the Node version and the tools this env  uses, even when the store already has them.

options.name: --no-audit
options.description: Skips the security audit after installing (it asks the npm registry).

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: A folder inside the env. The nem config is looked up  from there upwards.

commands.description: Puts the env's Node version and tools into the store  and creates their proxies. Tools also do this on first use.

commands.name: resolve

options.name: --shell
options.description: The syntax to answer in: sh, cmd or ps.

arguments.name: toolName
arguments.description: The tool a proxy was called as, e.g. 'ng'.

commands.description: Used by the proxies: installs what the env lacks, then  prints the tool to start and its environment, for a shell to run.

commands.name: run

arguments.name: toolName
arguments.description: The tool to run. Pass its arguments after a  '--' separator.

commands.description: Runs a tool from the nem env (or the system fallback).  Tool arguments follow the tool name.

commands.name: setup

options.name: --uninstall
options.description: Undoes the setup: takes the nem proxy directory back  out of your PATH and deletes the proxies. The store is left alone.

commands.description: Adds the nem proxy directory to your PATH. Only needs to  be run once; '--uninstall' takes it back out.

commands.name: store
list
commands.description: Lists the store's entries and when each was last  used.

commands.name: prune

options.name: --older-than
options.description: Removes entries no tool start used for this many  days. 0 removes every entry not in use right now.

commands.description: Removes entries no tool start used for a while  (default 180 days).
The store that holds the Node versions and tools of every  env.

commands.name: tool
add

arguments.name: package
arguments.description: The npm package to install into the env, e.g.  'ts-node' or 'ts-node@10.9.0'.

commands.description: Records an npm package in the nem config (it is  installed by 'nem install'), e.g. 'nem tool add  ts-node@10.9.0'.

commands.name: list
commands.description: Lists the tools of the env.

commands.name: remove

arguments.name: toolName
arguments.description: The npm package to remove from the env.

commands.description: Removes an npm package from the env.
Manages the tools of the env of the current directory.

commands.name: update

options.name: --tools
options.description: When updating the Node version, also update all tools  to the newest versions it supports.

arguments.name: what
arguments.description: What to update: a Node version (e.g. '22' or '18.12.0'), a tool package (e.g. 'typescript' or  '@angular/cli@22'), or 'all' for the Node version and every  tool. Omit to review and update interactively.

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: A folder inside the env. The nem config is looked up  from there upwards.

commands.description: Updates the env: a Node version ('22'), a tool  ('typescript', '@angular/cli@22'), or 'all'.  Without arguments it reviews the available updates interactively.

commands.name: which
commands.description: Explains which copy of a tool a typed name runs - global,  env or a project copy - and why.
